Game Development Essentials

This module is an introduction and foundation for students about to study Computer Game Design and Programming at British University Vietnam. It ensures that students have all the required skills, abilities and knowledge required to succeed at studying Game Design at an undergraduate level.

Learning Objectives for this module:

+  Students will be able to understand the founding principles of computer programming and write simple code.

+  Students will be able to understand what makes a game interesting and how the principles of creating new games.

+  Students will be able to understand and build interesting digital environments.
